summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting the announcement of dividend rates on its non-cumulative Rate Reset Class 1 Shares Series 3 and non-cumulative Floating Rate Class 1 Shares Series 4, as prescribed by the share terms. The fixed dividend rate for Series 3 from June 20, 2026 to June 19, 2031 was set at 4.64000% per annum, and the floating rate for Series 4 for the quarter ending September 19, 2026 was set at 3.73300% annualized. No special-situation event such as acquisition or restructuring is involved; this is a routine contractual dividend rate reset filing by the issuer.
